title: Shower Squeegee Solid Brass 15-Inch With Wall Hook | Polished Chrome | Squeegee Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Keep shower doors, tile, and mirrors clear after every rinse in Polished Chrome, which delivers a bright, mirror-like sheen that coordinates effortlessly with chrome faucets and modern fixtures. This wall-mounted shower squeegee (also called a shower glass squeegee or bathroom squeegee) removes moisture in quick, easy strokes and stores on the included decorative hook.

Highlights:
- Polished Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate a cohesive look with the Squeegee collection—designed to pair with transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories
- Built with solid brass materials (brass construction) and a blade that can be easily replaced

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 15 x 10 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 16 x 10 x 8 in.
- Shipping weight: 4 lb
- Includes: squeegee + mounting hook
multiple designer finish options available
